fusions.name: Twin Tines
fusions.desc: Looses 2 bolts of arcana side by side, each dealing 7 damage. Holds up to 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Branching Hex
fusions.desc: A two-pronged thrust of arcana that deals 12 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Diverting Prongs
fusions.desc: Bends incoming spells aside: for 6 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is turned back on whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Offshoot
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a forked spark of lightning splits off and deals 6 damage to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles. Once every 4 seconds.
